source.label: the NASA Exoplanet Archive's calculated radius (its Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relationship): a model, not a measurement, since 55 Cnc b does not transit

controls.label: Shape
controls.qualification: A sphere of the published radius, lit by 55 Cnc; the neutral gray is a display convention, not a measured color.
controls.notes: No image or color of 55 Cnc b is published: the sphere has its measured size, and the gray marks an unresolved surface. The lighting is its own star's, at the measured orbit. The gray takes the color of hd-75732's light, as its color dataset measures it.

charts.alt: The orbits of 55 Cnc's planets in this map from above, to scale, with 55 Cnc b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

physical.credit: Radius from the NASA Exoplanet Archive's calculated radius (its Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relationship): a model, not a measurement, since 55 Cnc b does not transit; mass from Moutou et al. (2026), A&A 705, A190, Table 3: minimum mass (m sin i) 276 +/- 9 Earth masses from the star's radial velocities; at the assumed tilt of 93.9 degrees the mass is 0.2% more; orbit from Moutou et al. (2026), A&A 705, A190, Table 3, a fit of the star's radial velocities (a/R* is its 0.118 au over the star's recorded 656,045 km); the orbit's plane is assumed, from Xiao et al. (2026, arXiv:2609.01377)
